title: Evaluate energy and force errors
action: Evaluate both trained potentials on a held‑out test set from the generated reference data. Compute the energy RMSE (meV/atom) and force RMSE (eV/Å) for each potential. Write the results to mhdnnp_vs_acsf_errors.csv.
description: Scored artifact comparing the mHDNNP against the ACSF‑only baseline. A successful reproduction must show substantially lower RMSE for the mHDNNP.
output_schema: CSV with columns: potential (string, 'ACSF-only' or 'mHDNNP'), split (string, 'train' or 'test'), metric (string, 'E_RMSE_meV_per_atom' or 'F_RMSE_eV_per_angstrom'), value (float).

title: Optimize lattice parameters of AFM‑II and FM phases
action: Using the trained mHDNNP, perform geometry optimization (relaxation of atomic positions and lattice vectors) for a 2×2×2 MnO supercell in the AFM‑II and FM magnetic configurations. Extract the converged lattice constant a (Å) and, for AFM‑II, the rhombohedral angle α (deg). Write the results to optimized_lattice_params.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the optimized lattice parameters, which reflect the magnetically induced structural distortion.
output_schema: JSON object: {"AFM-II": {"a": float, "alpha": float}, "FM": {"a": float}}. α is 90.0 for cubic FM.

title: Compute exchange constants and Néel temperatures
action: 1) Use the mHDNNP to compute the energies of AFM‑II, AFM‑I, and FM magnetic orders at the experimental cubic lattice constant a=4.430 Å and derive the mean‑field exchange constants J1, J2 (K) and Néel temperature T_N (K). 2) Perform MC spin‑flip simulations on a 6×6×6 MnO supercell with the same cubic lattice fixed at 4.430 Å, and determine the AFM‑II to paramagnetic transition temperature T_N_MC (K) from the heat capacity or order parameter. Write all results to exchange_neel.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the mean‑field exchange constants and both the mean‑field Néel temperature and the MC‑derived Néel temperature from explicit spin‑flip sampling.
output_schema: JSON object: {"J1": float, "J2": float, "T_N": float, "T_N_MC": float}. Values in Kelvin.
